text: 1AIII කොˁොටස - ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රික සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ අති විශෙˤෂ ගැැසට් පත්‍රය - 2025.01.08பகுதி III - இலங்்ககைச் சனநாயக சோசலிசக் குடியரசு வர்்த்்ததமானப் பத்்ததிரிகைகை - அதி விசேஷமானது - 2025.01.08
ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රික සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රයක සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රය
අති විශෙˤෂඅති විශෙˤෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

RUWANWELLA PRADESHIYA SABHA I hereby give notice for information of General Public that roads and paths should be adopted under no. E-23 at the General Meeting held on 13.10.2025 that roads and paths included in this Schedule should be declared as roads and paths for which an action hasn’t institute in the competent court on or before the date mentioned in the said notification among roads and paths deemed as belonged to Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha included in the schedule of the notification declared in the Gazette Notification No. 2429/05 dated 24.03.2025 under the Order made under Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987 in the series of Orders with regard to publishing notifications specifying register and preparation of plans of roads and paths maintained by Pradeshiya Sabha in Sabaragamuwa province having been declared by Hon. Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province in Extra Ordinary Gazette Notification No. 2316/20 dated 24th of Januarу, 2023

Register regarding the said roads and paths has included in the Schedule hereto and I further notify that every road and path included therein should be deemed as roads and paths belonged to Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub section (5) of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act.

I, further notify that register with regard to the said roads and paths has been included in the Schedule hereto and every road and path included therein should be deemed as roads and paths belonged to Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha under Section (5) of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act.
W.H.M.P.D. Waidyarathna, Chairman Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha.At Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha,At Ruwanwella26th November, 2025.
